motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of the August 12, 2025 Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Fox second…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to approve the minutes of the August 12, 2025 Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Fox seconded the motion.
motions.headline: August 12 commission minutes approved
motions.summary: The commission approved the minutes of its August 12, 2025 meeting.
motions.impact: This makes the written record of the last meeting official. You will not notice it.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Consolidated Fee Schedule. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A. An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Consolidated Fee Schedule. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Changes to the city fee schedule sent to council
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council amend the city's consolidated fee schedule, the single list of what the city charges for its services and permits.
motions.impact: Nothing changes yet: the council makes the final call. The motion does not say which fees would move or by how much, so whether you would pay more is not stated.
